DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)

The MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement are highly specific for PML, a demyelinating disease of the central nervous system typically caused by reactivation of the JC virus in immunocompromised patients. Given your history of limb ataxia and right-sided weakness, this diagnosis explains the focal neurological deficits you are experiencing. I will now request your current CD4 count and HIV status to confirm the underlying immunosuppression.
